title: Wrapyfi and human-participant research accepted at HRI 2024
excerpt: The University of Hamburg’s Knowledge Technology group announced that its human-participant study and Wrapyfi framework contribution were accepted at HRI 2024. Co-authored by Dr Di Fu, Wrapyfi connects robots, sensors and applications across multiple middleware frameworks.

zh.sourceName: 汉堡大学 - 知识技术

zh.title: Wrapyfi 与涉及人类参与者的研究获 HRI 2024 接收
zh.excerpt: 汉堡大学知识技术组宣布，其涉及人类参与者的研究及Wrapyfi框架贡献已被HRI 2024接收。Wrapyfi由Di Fu博士合著，可通过多种中间件框架连接机器人、传感器和应用程序。
